button.label: Multi-repo
button.title: A change across several repositories: one card per repository, run in dependency order

dialog.title: Multi-repo task
dialog.description: One change across several repositories. Each repository gets a card of its own project, started once the repositories it depends on passed QA.
dialog.taskPlaceholder: Describe the change across these repositories...
dialog.howItRuns: WorkPilot reads the repositories to order them (providers first), then runs each card through the usual spec, plan, code and QA. A card that needs you holds the run until you act on it from the board.
dialog.noProjects: No project on this computer yet: add a folder.
dialog.engineHint: Every repository gets a Kanban task running on this provider, model and effort, as if it had been picked on the board.

status.waitingOnRepo: Waiting for you on {{repo}}: open its card on the board.
